title: Spicy Shandong Noodle Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry featuring spicy Shandong sauce and noodles, served with tofu and a variety of vegetables.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.notes: rice noodles or soba noodles work well

instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together Shandong sauce and 2 cups of noodles cooking water.
In a large skillet or wok, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger; stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add tofu and stir-fry until golden brown.
Pour in the Shandong sauce mixture and bring to a simmer.
Add noodles and stir-fry until well coated.
